# CLI reference

```text
isummicron render --image IMAGE [options]
```

`python -m summicron.render.convolve` accepts the same flags. Back to the [README](../README.md).

## Basic

### `--image PATH`

Required.
Input image (HEIC, JPEG or PNG). LiDAR depth needs an iPhone Portrait HEIC; other images fall back to monocular depth under `--depth-source auto`.

### `--lens {35|50}`

Default: `35`. Choices: `35`, `50`.
Bundled lens. `35` (default): a 35 mm f/2 ray-traced from the expired US patent 3,006,249, Example II, using optiland. `50`: a 50 mm f/2 double-Gauss, the optiland sample prescription. Both are traced design prescriptions, not measurements of any production lens. Not combinable with `--tensor`.

### `--out-dir DIR`

Default: `unset`.
Output directory (default `./runs/render`). Writes `<stem>[_r<N>]_rendered[_ds<scale>].jpg` and `.png`.

### `--output PATH`

Default: `unset`.
Write exactly this file instead (`.png` writes PNG, anything else JPEG quality 95). Overrides `--out-dir`.

### `--depth-scale VALUE`

Default: `1.0`.
Multiplier on the depth map (meters) before focusing. Only the `linear` depth mapping uses it (the old look used 10); under `diopter` it is ignored with a warning.

### `--depth-source {auto|lidar|monocular}`

Default: `auto`. Choices: `auto`, `lidar`, `monocular`.
`auto`: `lidar` when the HEIC carries a depth image, otherwise `monocular` with a note. `lidar`: the HEIC's embedded depth (strict: errors without one). `monocular`: Depth Anything V2 Small (needs the `depth` extra; downloads about 100 MB on first use).

### `--focus-xy X Y`

Default: `unset`.
Focus point, normalized: X = column, Y = row, (0, 0) = top-left, each in [0, 1]. Omitted: the closest subject.

### `--downres N`

Default: `unset`.
Downsample so the long edge is N pixels (never upscales). Adds `_r<N>` to output names. 2048 is the fast preview size.

### `--hdr-source {auto|none|macos}`

Default: `auto`. Choices: `auto`, `none`, `macos`.
`auto`: `macos` when the macOS loader is available and the photo carries a gain map, else `none` with a note. `none`: 8-bit SDR load. `macos`: load the HDR gain map with Core Image and tonemap back to SDR, so highlights keep headroom (macOS 15+, `hdr-macos` extra).

### `--occlusion-compositing {off|on}`

Default: `off`. Choices: `off`, `on`.
`on`: layered compositing that stacks the depth layers front to back, for about 1.3–1.6× render time. Off by default: with real-lens blur it only changes a hairline along the subject's outline.

## Depth and tone

### `--depth-guided {auto|off|on}`

Default: `auto`. Choices: `auto`, `off`, `on`.
Light luminance-guided smoothing of the LiDAR depth staircase. `auto`: `on` with LiDAR depth, else `off`. An explicit `on` needs LiDAR depth.

### `--depth-mapping {auto|linear|diopter}`

Default: `auto`. Choices: `auto`, `linear`, `diopter`.
How depth maps onto the PSF table's distance axis. `auto`: `diopter` with LiDAR depth, else `linear`. `linear`: `depth * --depth-scale` (the pre-0.4.0 look). `diopter`: reciprocal-depth distance from the focus point; ignores `--depth-scale`. An explicit `diopter` needs LiDAR depth.

### `--depth-gain VALUE`

Default: `auto`.
Gain of the `diopter` mapping: `auto` (a fixed 1.0, the physical value) or a number in (0, 10]. Larger means more blur and a narrower sharp zone.

### `--tonemap {auto|ci|input-lut}`

Default: `auto`. Choices: `auto`, `ci`, `input-lut`.
Final HDR-to-SDR tone. `auto`: `input-lut` when `--hdr-source macos` delivers HDR headroom and shadow match is off, else `ci`. `ci`: the Apple Core Image tonemap. `input-lut`: reproduce the input photo's own SDR tone with a measured luma curve. An explicit `input-lut` needs `--hdr-source macos`.

## Highlights

### `--bright-pass-thresh VALUE`

Default: `unset`.
Linear-luminance level above which pixels bloom as highlights. Unset or `auto`: chosen per image from the tonemap. A number is used as given; 1e9 disables.

### `--bright-pass-region-size N`

Default: `31`.
Highlight detector size in pixels (0–255; 0 turns the region gate off). Suggested 15 small lights, 31 default, 63 large lights.

### `--bright-pass-floor VALUE`

Default: `0.1`.
0–1. Bloom kept outside detected highlights (0 strict, 1 no gate). Used when region size > 0.

### `--bright-pass-norm-pct VALUE`

Default: `99.0`.
50–100. Detector percentile that sets the bloom scale. Used when region size > 0.

## Advanced

### `--tensor PATH`

Default: `unset`.
Your own PSF tensor `.npz` (see "Bring your own PSF tensor" in the usage guide; `scripts/build_psf` builds one with optiland). Default: the bundled tensor chosen by `--lens`. Not combinable with `--lens`.

### `--focus-target-m VALUE`

Default: `unset`.
Advanced. Tensor focus distance in meters (default: the tensor's own, 0.7 m for the shipped tensor). Other values warn that the subject may not be sharp.

### `--slab-batch-size N`

Default: `unset`.
Depth slabs per batch (default 1). Larger values only use more memory; output is identical.

## Shadow match (experimental)

### `--shadow-match-mode {off|on}`

Default: `off`. Choices: `off`, `on`.
Experimental. `on` matches shadow colour to the SDR input before tonemapping. Needs `--hdr-source macos`.

### `--shadow-band-hi VALUE`

Default: `0.7`.
0–1. Upper luma bound of the matched band.

### `--shadow-match-max-gain VALUE`

Default: `4.0`.
1–16. Cap on the per-channel gain.

### `--shadow-match-strength VALUE`

Default: `1.0`.
0–4. Strength multiplier (1.0 = exact match).

## Bright stamp (experimental)

### `--bright-stamp {auto|peak|l1}`

Default: `auto`. Choices: `auto`, `peak`, `l1`.
Experimental. Bright-pass stamp: `auto` is `l1`; `peak` is the peak-normalized kernel; `l1` is the L1-normalized kernel times `--bright-stamp-gain`.

### `--bright-stamp-gain VALUE`

Default: `unset`.
Experimental. Gain of the `l1` bright stamp, a number in (0, 16] (default 2.0 under an `l1` stamp).

## Removed in 0.5.0

These flags are still recognised but only to stop with a one-line error. See "Migrating to 0.5.0" in the [CHANGELOG](../CHANGELOG.md).

- `--kernel-family`: `render: --kernel-family was removed in 0.5.0; the only PSF source is the ray-traced lens tensor (use --lens 35|50 or --tensor PATH). See 'Migrating to 0.5.0' in CHANGELOG.md.`
- `--lens-aperture-mm`: `render: --lens-aperture-mm was removed in 0.5.0; the only PSF source is the ray-traced lens tensor (use --lens 35|50 or --tensor PATH). See 'Migrating to 0.5.0' in CHANGELOG.md.`
- `--psf-norm`: `render: --psf-norm was removed in 0.5.0; PSFs are always L1-normalised. See 'Migrating to 0.5.0' in CHANGELOG.md.`

## Environment variables

- `ISUMMICRON_MAX_BYTES`: Memory budget in bytes for the pre-render guard (default 12 GiB). A render estimated above it stops with a message that names a `--downres` that fits.
- `ISUMMICRON_DEBUG`: Set to any value other than empty or `0` to print the full traceback instead of the one-line `render: <msg>` error.

## Exit codes

- `0`: the render finished.
- `2`: an input or option error; one line `render: <message>` on stderr.
